solution: Local check gives rapid feedback without a request. Server cannot trust arbitrary clients, so it revalidates received data. The authoritative database is server-side, and uniqueness must be checked there against current stored records.

Server revalidates because clients can bypass checks.
Authoritative stored data are on server.
Uniqueness checked against current database, not only local client state.
